name: Menu
summary: A list of places to go, with groups that fold away. The groups are <details> elements, so the browser opens and closes them and keeps them open across a reload.
summaryZh: 一串可以去的地方,其中的分组可以收起来。分组用的是 <details> 元素,所以开关由浏览器负责,刷新之后还会保持原来的展开状态。

variants.name: Horizontal
variants.note: The entries run along the top and each group's submenu hangs under the group it belongs to.

states.name: Group open
states.note: The group's <details> is open, so its submenu is showing and its marker points down.

parts.name: Active
parts.note: The entry the reader is on. It goes on the item next to um-menu__item, and its own link is the one that is filled.

parts.name: Group
parts.note: A group of entries. It holds the <details> that opens and closes.

parts.name: Title
parts.note: The <summary> that opens the group. Its marker is a shape drawn from two borders.

parts.name: Icon
parts.note: An empty slot for the host's own glyph. The library draws no icons and loads no icon font; the slot only holds the space so the text does not move.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the entries run. The vertical menu is the base class on its own; the horizontal menu adds um-menu--horizontal.
props.descriptionZh: 菜单往哪个方向排。纵向是只写基类;横向再加上 um-menu--horizontal。

props.name: active
props.description: Which entry is the current one. It is the um-menu__active class on that entry's item.
props.descriptionZh: 当前是哪一个条目。它是那个条目的 item 上的 um-menu__active 类。

props.name: mode
props.description: Which way the entries run. This is Element Plus's name for the `direction` prop; either one of them lays the menu out.
props.descriptionZh: 菜单往哪个方向排。这是 Element Plus 对 `direction` 属性的叫法,两个都能决定菜单怎么排。

slots.name: icon
slots.description: The glyph in front of an entry. It goes inside the icon slot, which is empty by default.
slots.descriptionZh: 条目前面的图标,放在图标位里。图标位默认是空的。

slots.name: title
slots.description: The title of the group. It goes in the group's summary, beside the marker.
slots.descriptionZh: 分组的标题。它放在分组的 summary 里,紧挨着标记。

events.name: open
events.description: Fires when a group opens. It is the browser's own toggle event on the group's <details>, caught on the way down.
events.descriptionZh: 某个分组展开时触发。这是分组那个 <details> 上的浏览器原生 toggle 事件,在向下传播的路上被接住。

events.name: close
events.description: Fires when a group closes. It is the browser's own toggle event on the group's <details>, caught on the way down.
events.descriptionZh: 某个分组收起时触发。这是分组那个 <details> 上的浏览器原生 toggle 事件,在向下传播的路上被接住。

events.name: select
events.description: Fires when an entry is pressed. It carries the text of the entry and the event itself.
events.descriptionZh: 某个条目被按下时触发。它带着这个条目的文字和事件本身。

a11y.notes: The menu is a <ul> of <li>s, so the entries are announced as a list and the reader hears how many there are. A group is a <details> with a <summary>, so it opens with Enter or Space and the browser says whether it is open or closed. The icon slot is aria-hidden: it is empty in the markup, and whatever the host puts there is decoration beside a label that is already read out.
a11y.notesZh: 菜单是一个由 <li> 组成的 <ul>,所以条目会作为列表播报,读屏能听出共有多少条。分组是带 <summary> 的 <details>,按 Enter 或空格就能展开,浏览器也会播报它是开着还是关着的。图标位加了 aria-hidden:标记里它是空的,宿主放进去的东西也只是文字旁边的一个装饰。

examples.title: Vertical
examples.description: A vertical menu with one group. The group is a <details>, so the browser owns the open and closed state and the marker is drawn by the stylesheet.
examples.descriptionZh: 带一个分组的纵向菜单。分组是 <details>,开关状态归浏览器管,标记由样式表画出来。
examples.markup:
• Dashboard
  • Orders
  • Reports
    • Monthly
    • Year to date

examples.title: Horizontal
examples.description: The horizontal variant runs the entries along the top and hangs the submenu under the group. The submenu is a panel of its own there, so it sits on the overlay surface and carries a shadow.
examples.descriptionZh: 横向变体把条目排在上面,子菜单吊在分组下面。这时候子菜单自己就是一块面板,所以它压在浮层底色上,还带一层阴影。
examples.markup:
• Product
  • Pricing
  • Docs
    • Getting started
    • API

notes: The icon slot is deliberately empty. The library ships no icon font and no image, so the slot is a sized empty span the host fills with whatever it already uses — an inline SVG, a sprite, a character. It carries the space either way, so adding a glyph does not move the text.
notesZh: 图标位是故意留空的。库里不带图标字体,也不带图片,所以它就是一个有尺寸的空 span,宿主拿自己现成的东西填进去 —— 内联的 SVG、雪碧图或者一个字符都行。它无论如何都占着那个位置,所以补上图标不会把文字挤走。
